title: Report: Alleged scam artist was "desperately" seeking $75,000 loan on the day he died

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Alleged scam artist was "desperately" seeking $75,000 loan on the day he died
sources.description: The case of Mohamed Coulibaly is sending shock waves throughout the NFL, as it relates to many people in the league (including coaches, executives, and players) who actually invested with him, who supposedly did (but actually didn't), and/or who had been solicited to invest.
